moment.text: The Rokkasen ("six poetry immortals") are six Japanese poets of the mid-ninth century who were named by Ki no Tsurayuki in the kana and mana prefaces to the poetry anthology Kokin wakashū (c. 905–14) as notable poets of the generation before its compilers.

matters.text: The poetry of Ariwara Narihira tries to express too much content in too few words. It resembles a faded flower with a lingering fragrance. … Ono no Komachi belongs to the same line as Sotoorihime of old. Her poetry is moving and lacking in strength.
